mapper.select: SELECT total_ent_count FROM stat_ent_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT daily_handle_count FROM stat_approval_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 AND date = #{date} ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT total_pol_amount FROM stat_pol_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT appeal_resp_rate FROM stat_appeal_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sr.region_code as regionCode,
(SELECT region_name FROM sys_area WHERE region_code = sr.region_code) as regionName, SUM(sr.ent_count) as entCount FROM stat_ent_rpt sr WHERE sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.region_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sr.region_code ORDER BY entCount DESC
SELECT date as date, SUM(handle_count) as handleCount FROM stat_approval_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 AND date BETWEEN #{beginDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC
